Let

\[
\rho_x=\frac{1-\omega_x}{\omega_x}
=
\begin{cases}
1/3,&S_x=R,\\
3,&S_x=L.
\end{cases}
\]

For one-dimensional RWRE, the direction is determined by \(\mathbb E_\theta\log \rho_0\). Here

\[
\mathbb E_\theta\log \rho_0
=\theta\log(1/3)+(1-\theta)\log 3
=(1-2\theta)\log 3.
\]

Thus the recurrent value is

\[
\theta_{\rm dir}=\frac12.
\]

For the second moment of \(T_1\), the relevant criterion is

\[
\varrho\!\left(P_{\alpha,\theta}\operatorname{diag}(\rho_R^2,\rho_L^2)\right)<1,
\]

where \(\varrho\) denotes spectral radius. Since \(\rho_R^2=1/9\) and \(\rho_L^2=9\), we need the largest eigenvalue of

\[
P_{\alpha,\theta}
\begin{pmatrix}
1/9&0\\
0&9
\end{pmatrix}
\]

to be \(<1\). The threshold \(\theta_+\) occurs when \(1\) is an eigenvalue.

Write \(q=1-\alpha\). Then

\[
P_{\alpha,\theta}=
\begin{pmatrix}
\alpha+q\theta&q(1-\theta)\\
q\theta&\alpha+q(1-\theta)
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

So the threshold equation is

\[
\det\!\left(I-
P_{\alpha,\theta}
\begin{pmatrix}
1/9&0\\
0&9
\end{pmatrix}
\right)=0.
\]

That is

\[
\left(1-\frac{\alpha+q\theta}{9}\right)
\left(1-9(\alpha+q(1-\theta))\right)
-q^2\theta(1-\theta)=0.
\]

Using \(\alpha+q(1-\theta)=1-q\theta\), this becomes

\[
\frac{9-\alpha-q\theta}{9}(-8+9q\theta)-q^2\theta(1-\theta)=0.
\]

Multiplying by \(9\) and simplifying,

\[
-8(9-\alpha)+80q\theta=0.
\]

Hence

\[
\theta_+=\frac{9-\alpha}{10(1-\alpha)}.
\]

Similarly, for \(T_{-1}\) one uses \(\rho^{-2}\), equivalently swaps \(R\) and \(L\), so

\[
\theta_-=1-\theta_+
=\frac{1-9\alpha}{10(1-\alpha)}.
\]

Because \(0<\alpha<1/9\), these satisfy

\[
0<\theta_-<\frac12<\theta_+<1.
\]

Therefore

\[
\boxed{
\left(
\frac{1-9\alpha}{10(1-\alpha)},
\frac12,
\frac{9-\alpha}{10(1-\alpha)}
\right)
}
\]
